title: The Hehuan Bell and the Heavenly Book
summary: Bi Yao bows to the Wisdom King and the Holy Mother as a 43rd-generation disciple. Behind Ancient Corpse Poison, Black Heart Elder had hidden only a pair of bells: the Hehuan Bell of Madam Jinling, founder of the He Huan Sect. Bi Yao explains that Jinling and Black Heart Elder were lovers from rival sects 800 years ago. Ghost fire then reveals carvings of the Heavenly Book, the Demon Sect's classic, and Zhang Xiaofan is shaken to find lines from the Great Brahma Prajna and the Taiji Xuanqing Dao in it. With the food gone, Bi Yao asks him to kill her and eat her so he can live, then tries to kill herself. When he stops her, she tells him how she and her mother were buried in a cave by the Tian Yin monk Pu Fang, how her mother fed her until she died, and how her father seemed to want to kill her when he came. She prays with her own blood to send Xiaofan home to Great Bamboo Peak. That sets off the Lovestruck Mantra, which opens the exit. They escape as the cave collapses, and Xiaofan cooks her a meal.
